full_judgment: 3. An appeal was preferred being T.A. No. 42 of 1982 before the District Judge, Dhaka. After numerous adjournments on the prayer of the defendants the matter ultimately was heard by the District Judge and as no one appeared for the defendants-appellants the District Judge dismissed the appeal for default. An application under Order 41 Rule 19 of the Code of Civil Procedure for restoration of the appeal was filed which again was contested by the plaintiff by filing written objection. The District Judge on consideration of evidence and after hearing both the parties dismissed the Misc. Case arising out of the application under Order 41 Rule 19 of the Code of Civil Procedure. As against the said order for dismissal of Misc. Case being Misc. Case No. 70 of 1982 the defendants moved the High Court Division for admission of the Misc. Appeal being F.M .A.T. No. 290 of 1982. The learned Single Judge adopted a procedure which is not sanctioned by the Code of Civil Procedure. The learned Single Judge set aside the order of the District Judge passed in Misc. Case No. 70 of 1982 and restored the said appeal to its file and number and pending disposal of the T.A. being Appeal No. 42 of 1982 by the District Judge, the High Court Division stayed further proceeding in Title Execution Case No. 10 of 1982.
